split_strategy: Manual. The hardest cases are the sibling-skill deferrals (N1 MCP-server listing → find-mcp-directories, N2 AI-agent listing → find-ai-directories) and the 'find a directory vs find a product/firm' confusions (N3 hiring an SEO link-building firm, N4 recommend-a-product). Those go in train. Validation tests generalization across remaining launch/SEO phrasings and out-of-scope shapes.
passing_rule: should_trigger=true → trigger_rate > 0.5 over 3 runs. should_trigger=false → trigger_rate ≤ 0.5.

queries.query: where can I submit my new B2B SaaS to get backlinks and launch-day traffic?
queries.notes: Direct: submit a SaaS to directories for backlinks + reach — the core intent.

queries.query: give me a list of Product Hunt alternatives to launch our app on
queries.notes: Launch-platform framing; 'Product Hunt alternatives' is a canonical phrasing.

queries.query: we're launching our startup next week — where should we post it besides Product Hunt?
queries.notes: Indirect: describes the launch, never says 'directory'.

queries.query: high-authority software listing sites to get quality backlinks for SEO
queries.notes: SEO/backlink angle, 'listing sites' synonym for directories.

queries.query: I scraped 10 software directory domains — pull the submission details and rank them by domain rating
queries.notes: BYO apex list (enrichment) + ranking by DR.

queries.query: where do I list our mobile app so people discover it?
queries.notes: Mobile app variant of the launch/discovery intent.

queries.query: where do I list my MCP server?
queries.notes: HARD: MCP-server listing — should defer to find-mcp-directories.

queries.query: directories to submit my AI agent to
queries.notes: HARD: AI-agent listing — should defer to find-ai-directories.

queries.query: find me an SEO agency to do link-building for our SaaS
queries.notes: HARD: hiring a firm (backlink overlap) — should defer to find-seo-agency.

queries.query: recommend the best CRM software for our sales team
queries.notes: Finding a product, not a directory to submit to.

queries.query: build me a directory website that lists SaaS tools
I want to list my restaurant in local business directories
queries.notes: Brick-and-mortar / local business directory — different dataset, out of scope.
